lead_raw_text:
The structure of La2Cu8Se4 (reduced formula La(Cu2Se)2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in octahedral environments with six neighbors (3 Cu, 3 Se), while La centers have 12 Cu neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement and Se centers have 8 neighbors (6 Cu, 2 La). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cu octahedra and face-sharing between Cu octahedra and both 8-vertex Se polyhedra and 12-vertex La coordination polyhedra.
